# Asadullah Shafique — Agentic AI Developer

> Portfolio of Asadullah Shafique: agentic AI developer, full-stack engineer (Next.js 15 / TypeScript / Python / FastAPI), founder of Texcot Embroidery Sourcing House, and Panaversity hackathon champion (6 consecutive wins, zero failures). Based in Pakistan, serving Pakistan and UAE markets.

This site is itself an agentic system: the portfolio includes a multi-mode AI chat agent
(Portfolio Guide, Backend Specialist, Frontend Architect, Agent Builder) backed by a
FastAPI service with streaming SSE.

## How I build agents

- Harness Engineering (The Environment): tools, memory, permissions, observability — the safety net around the model.
- Loop Engineering (The Feedback): evidence over confidence — agents stop when tests pass, not when they feel done.
- Graph Engineering (The Flow): branching, approvals, retries, parallel tasks — orchestration of the full workflow.
